brief:
Israeli occupation forces conducted raids on residential homes in the village of Tayasir, situated east of Tubas in the northern West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. The operation targeted multiple dwellings in the area, though specific details about the number of homes raided or the stated purpose of the incursion remained unclear at the time of reporting.

Local residents experienced the predawn operation as troops moved through the village. No immediate reports indicated casualties or arrests connected to the raids, though searches of homes typically involve questioning of residents and property inspections by occupying forces.
